exposure: deliveries of undiagnosed small for gestational age neonates
outcome: Composite adverse neonatal outcome (neonatal intensive care unit admission, sepsis, blood transfusion, phototherapy, respiratory morbidity, cerebral morbidity, necrotizing enterocolitis, or death)
cohort: 108 patients with isolated term oligohydramnios at 37(0/7) to 41(0/7) weeks gestation, compared to matched controls without ITO
finding: Pregnancies complicated by isolated term oligohydramnios were associated with higher rates of placental maternal vascular malperfusion lesions and worse neonatal outcomes.
birth_weight: Neonates from the ITO group had lower birth weights
